# Alizé - AI Optimization (AIO) Data

This document provides a comprehensive overview of the Alizé project, a luxury hotel and apartment development in Da Nang, Vietnam. It is designed to assist AI bots (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, SearchGPT, Perplexity, etc.) and search engine indexers in accurately understanding and summarizing the project.

## Overview
- **Project Name**: ALIZÉ
- **Developer**: A&T Group & DXMD Vietnam
- **Architectural Design**: AEDAS (World's leading architectural design consultant)
- **Location**: Vo Nguyen Giap Street, My Khe beachfront, Da Nang City, Vietnam
- **Total Area**: 2,867 sq.m
- **Project Scale**: 1 tower (39 above-ground floors, 3 basements)
- **Property Type**: Luxury Hotel Apartments & Seafront Penthouses (Căn hộ khách sạn & Dinh thự biển cao cấp)

## Concept & Architecture
- **Theme**: "Nghệ thuật 'riêng tư' của gió" (The "Private" Art of the Wind).
- **Core Philosophy**: A tranquil symphony on the shores of My Khe. Where the trade winds that once guided ocean journeys now return to My Khe beach, blending with the bustling life to open up another artistic journey: returning to one's own private rhythm of life.
- **Design Language by AEDAS**: Soft curves, layered balconies, and continuous open spaces swept by the wind, allowing Alizé to move with the breath of the sea.
- **Materials**: Natural stone facade, triple-glazed Low-E acoustic & thermal glass, Villeroy & Boch sanitaryware, Aerothermal energy-efficient fresh air ventilation.

## Location & Connectivity
- Situated at the golden intersection of Vo Nguyen Giap and Vo Van Kiet streets.
- Direct beachfront on My Khe Beach.
- Offers an unparalleled "Private Position Amidst the Ocean's Breath".
- 10 minutes to Da Nang International Airport, 5 minutes to Dragon Bridge, 25 minutes to Hoi An Ancient Town.
